AdmittedWideEngine::prepare_job -> AdmittedWideJob<'_, R> (job(), reserved_bytes(), convert_band, convert_band_in_place, finish -> AdmittedWideJobResult<R> {result(), reserved_bytes()}); leases: work (band table + Observe frame + actor + resource id; released at finish/drop), receipt (ids x4; travels with the result), plan (kept with the cached plan) + build (transient) on a miss; context/revision/layout refused before any charge; miss_charges helper shared with transform (same reservation order, existing wide_admitted test green)

WideError additive variants band_index, band_claimed, band_length, job_incomplete (no exhaustive WideError match in any dependent: develop maps with a catch-all, interop-psd uses codes); AdmittedWideError unchanged; WIDE_DESCRIPTOR job_route (JSON validated)

bit identity: per-pixel Plan::pixel + clip scan identical to transform; band digest = serial request digest of that band; job digest = SHA-256 over band digests in band order (JOB_DIGEST_RULE); merged clip report == serial whole-frame clip report

notes.api_for_develop: per frame: let job = wide.prepare_job(&WideJobRequest { source: WideSource::Profile(src), destination: dst, bands: WideBands::Sizes(&tile_pixel_counts) /* one band per tile, tile order */, intent: Intent::RelativeColorimetric, black_point_compensation: false, revision, expected_revision: revision, correlation_id, resource_id, actor }, cancel).map_err(map_admitted)?; then inside develop's std::thread::scope workers: job.convert_band_in_place(tile_index, tile_rgb.as_flattened_mut(), cancel) (or convert_band(tile_index, &in, &mut out, cancel)) -> WideBandReport {clip, output_sha256} | WideError (map_wide); after the scope: let done = job.finish(cancel, sink).map_err(map_admitted)?; done.result().receipt.receipt.clip is the merged clip report; plan hits/misses/parses still from wide.cache_stats() after finish. The engine stays mutably borrowed until finish/drop. One observation per job (not per tile). Band errors are per band; finish reports the lowest failed or unconverted band.
